The framework is\\r\\ndeliberately conservative: emergence statements are paired with computable functionals,\\r\\nreproducible pipelines, explicit domain statements, and failure-domain reporting. We define\\r\\na measurement layer {ρ,K,Kρ|σ,D, gρ, k(q), bL, ν, TP ,dρ,Sgeo} and a flow layer based on\\r\\nCPTP-consistent modular dynamics with a reference state σ. Two bridge theorems (with\\r\\nproof sketches) connect CPTP contractivity to information geometry and stable locality\\r\\nto well-posed MI-graph geometry.
